verdict.rationale: No bulk or batch operation is documented. The closest evidence is indirect. The CLI, SDKs and MCP server expose programmatic resource management (create, update, list agents), which a user could script into loops. Per-agent data retention automatically deletes call data in aggregate. Conductor can filter and compare many conversations at once, which is bulk analysis rather than bulk action. missing for 10: native bulk or batch endpoints or commands (e.g., batch calls, bulk update or delete of agents, numbers or contacts), documentation of multi-item operations in the CLI or MCP, and hands-on corroboration.
